verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names any CPU architecture beyond x86 and ARM, and never mentions PowerPC. The only architecture claim is a generic statement that llamafile runs on "most operating systems and CPU architectures," which does not show inference on any non-x86/ARM target. The axis applies to a local LLM runtime, but there is no evidence the capability is delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
